security_implications: This chunk directly controls write enables for HMAC secret key, wipe_secret, digest, and message length registers by aggregating them into reg_we_check. An erroneous assertion of any *_we signal (e.g., due to a bus interface bug or glitch) will be passed through immediately, allowing unauthorized writes to security-critical storage. This could lead to key corruption, digest manipulation, or wiping of secrets without proper lifecycle checks. The integrity of the mapping is paramount, and any mistake in the index assignment could cross-couple writes, potentially enabling covert side-channel attacks or privilege escalation.
